wizard.welcome.text: Welcome, let's set up your talking helper.

wizard.cloud_default.text: Use your Hermes subscription to listen and speak.

wizard.upgrade_local_speech.text: Have your helper hear and speak on this device.

wizard.upgrade_gpu_voices.text: Use a stronger device for nicer voices.

wizard.upgrade_fast_model.text: Pick a quicker helper for faster answers.

wizard.needs_ffmpeg.text: Your helper needs one extra piece to speak.

talk.hold_to_talk.text: Hold the button while you talk.

talk.still_working.text: Please wait, I am still working on it.

talk.didnt_catch.text: I did not catch that, please say it again.

talk.hold_longer.text: Please hold the button a bit longer.

talk.too_long.text: That talk was too long, please try a shorter one.

talk.mic_blocked.text: Your microphone seems covered, please open it.

talk.no_voice_setup.text: Your talking helper is not set up yet.

watch.find.text: Tap the button to find your watch.

watch.searching.text: I am looking for your watch now.

watch.approve.text: Check your watch for the number {code}.

watch.not_found_same_wifi.text: Put your watch and this computer on the same home Wi-Fi.

watch.cant_reach.text: I cannot reach your watch right now.

watch.lost_connection.text: I lost touch with your watch.

watch.forget.text: Do you want to forget this watch?

watch.battery.text: Your watch battery is at {percent} percent.

sessions.open_in_hermes.text: Open this talk in the Hermes app.

sessions.new_slot.text: Make room for a new talk.

memory.confirm_save.text: Do you want to save this note: {text}?

character.upload_face.text: Upload a face picture for your helper.

character.face_too_big.text: That face picture is too big.

soul.preview.text: Look at this personality before you save it.

soul.reset.text: Do you want to reset the personality?

error.generic.text: Something went wrong, so please try again.
